name: Ijen Geopark Run 2026
short_description: A half-marathon event on August 23, 2026, at Paltuding Camp in the Kawasan Ijen Geopark, Banyuwangi, Indonesia, with registration currently open.
ai_summary: The Ijen Geopark Run 2026 is a half-marathon event scheduled for August 23, 2026, held at Paltuding Camp within the Kawasan Ijen Geopark in Banyuwangi, Jawa Timur, Indonesia. Organized by the Geopark Run Series, the race offers three distance options: 5km, 10km, and 21.1km, with the half-marathon serving as the primary distance. Registration is currently open for participants interested in joining this Indonesian race set within a geopark landscape.

research_highlights: This is the inaugural edition of the Ijen Geopark Run brand and the opening leg of the new Geopark Run Series 2026-2027, held in the Ijen UNESCO Global Geopark area of Banyuwangi.
Race day is Sunday 23 August 2026, with race pack collection (RPC) scheduled for 21-22 August 2026 in Banyuwangi city.
Categories on offer are 5K, 10K and Half Marathon (21K).
Organizers describe roughly 2,000 total slots with a limited 'Super Early Bird' batch of only 100 slots, and registration ran from 22 May to 19 July 2026.
The venue/start area is listed as Bumi Perkemahan Paltuding – Curah Macan, Tamansari, Licin, Banyuwangi — the same volcanic mountain area used for other Ijen sport-tourism events.
research_watchouts: This is a first-year event under this new name/format, so there are no participant race reports yet for the road-race distances (5K/10K/21K) specifically.

A related but distinct trail event in the same Ijen Geopark area (Ijen Green Trail Run 2025, with 8/14/25/50km trail categories) was described by finishers as having a genuinely tough, demanding course with steep climbs and rocky, uneven terrain — worth noting since the Geopark Run road event uses the same volcanic highland region.
Because the event sits in the Ijen crater highlands, expect cool mountain conditions rather than lowland tropical heat, based on how organizers and past related events describe the terrain.

faqs.question: When is the Ijen Geopark Run 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Ijen Geopark Run 2026 is scheduled to take place on August 23, 2026. The event will be held at Paltuding Camp, located within the Kawasan Ijen Geopark in Banyuwangi, Jawa Timur, Indonesia, offering runners a distinctive geopark setting for the race.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at this event?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from three distance options at the Ijen Geopark Run 2026: 5km, 10km, or 21.1km. The 21.1km half-marathon serves as the primary distance for the event, though shorter options are available for those seeking a less demanding race.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Ijen Geopark Run 2026?
faqs.answer: The Ijen Geopark Run 2026 is organized by the Geopark Run Series. The race takes place at Paltuding Camp within the Kawasan Ijen Geopark in Banyuwangi, Jawa Timur, Indonesia, as part of the organizer's broader series of geopark-based running events.

faqs.question: Is registration currently open for this race?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Ijen Geopark Run 2026 is currently open. Prospective participants interested in the 5km, 10km, or 21.1km half-marathon distances can register ahead of the event date of August 23, 2026, at Paltuding Camp in Banyuwangi.
